About

Italian artist based in Berlin. Acrylic on canvas.

Bio

Rossella works in acrylic on canvas, building up layered, weathered surfaces one glaze at a time — scraping back, repainting, letting each piece find its own texture over weeks rather than sittings.

Now based in Berlin, her work moves between quiet, worn neutrals and sudden fields of colour, often shown the way it's meant to be seen: on the wall, in the room, at scale.
